approval_evidence.quote: Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals ... 02/28/2011 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity STANDARD (NDA 022522; current company on Drugs@FDA: ASTRAZENECA)

series_start_reason: Longest contiguous series. Daliresp was printed by AstraZeneca from 2015Q2 as 'Daliresp' (US and Canada); from 2016Q2 the line is 'Daliresp / Daxas' (Daxas, the ex-U.S. name, added after the Takeda respiratory acquisition), a change of definition, so the 2015Q2-2016Q1 piece is delivered separately as astrazeneca_daliresp_alt. Forest/Actavis/Allergan sales before March 2015 are not AstraZeneca documents and Forest's fiscal quarters (March year-end) do not align.
series_end_reason: AstraZeneca's Q1 2024 and later results releases print no Daliresp row (included in 'Other R&I'); last printed quarter is 2023Q4 ('Daliresp/Daxas' 13).
notes: Label is 'Daliresp / Daxas' (2016Q2-2020Q4, some periods 'Daliresp/Daxas'), 'Daliresp' (2021Q1-2022Q3) and 'Daliresp/Daxas' (2022Q4-2023Q4) without a change of definition: values are continuous across the renames.
search_log: listed AstraZeneca (CIK 0000901832) filings via data.sec.gov submissions incl. filings.files older page: 1,614 6-K, 6 6-K/A, 24 20-F (all form types counted, 6-K/A included)

fetched the main document of every 6-K/20-F filed 2003-2026 (monthly 6-Ks of 2003-2011 embed the full results press releases; 2012+ one 6-K per results announcement); 2002 6-Ks before Nov 2002 are 'AUTO-GENERATED PAPER DOCUMENT' (not on EDGAR)

located each quarterly results release by the product-sales table containing Symbicort; extracted the product row from the table anchored on the Symbicort row of the same release (table index + row stored in scripts/az_onepass.py output)
cross-checked Symbicort chain: era-A releases print the prior-year quarter, which equals the earlier release's current quarter for every year 2003-2014

AstraZeneca acquired Daliresp US and Canada rights from Actavis plc (Forest Laboratories' successor) in March 2015 (Q2 2016 release text); Forest Laboratories had a March fiscal year, so its quarters do not align with calendar quarters and were not used
first AstraZeneca Daliresp sales row: H1 2015 release (stacked with Tudorza / Eklira); Q1 2015 release prints none
Q2 2016 release: Daxas (marketed ex-US) added after the Takeda respiratory acquisition; label becomes 'Daliresp / Daxas'
no Daliresp row in the 2024 and 2025-26 releases (zero occurrences of the word in those results documents)
